elements.Name: Beryllium
elements.Name origin: Beryl, mineral (ultimately after Belur, Karnataka, India)

elements.Name: Boron
elements.Name origin: Borax, mineral (from Arabic: bawraq, Middle Persian: *bōrag)

elements.Name: Sodium
elements.Name origin: Coined by Humphry Davy who first isolated it, from English soda (specifically caustic soda), via Italian from Arabic ṣudāʕ 'headache'

elements.Name: Aluminium
elements.Name origin: Alumina, from Latin alumen (gen. aluminis) 'bitter salt, alum'

elements.Name: Titanium
elements.Name origin: Titans, children of Gaia and Ouranos

elements.Name: Vanadium
elements.Name origin: Vanadis, a name for Norse goddess Freyja

elements.Name: Manganese
elements.Name origin: Corrupted from magnesia negra; see magnesium

elements.Name: Iron
elements.Name origin: English, from Proto-Celtic *īsarnom 'iron', from a root meaning 'blood'

elements.Name: Nickel
elements.Name origin: Nickel, a mischievous sprite in German miner mythology

elements.Name: Copper
elements.Name origin: English, from Latin cuprum, after Cyprus

elements.Name: Zinc
elements.Name origin: Most likely German Zinke, 'prong, tooth', but some suggest Persian sang 'stone'

elements.Name: Arsenic
elements.Name origin: Middle English, from Middle French arsenic, from Greek arsenikón 'yellow arsenic' (influenced by arsenikós 'masculine, virile'), from a West Asian wanderword ultimately from Old Persian: *zarniya-ka, lit. 'golden'

elements.Name: Strontium
elements.Name origin: Strontian, a village in Scotland, where it was found

elements.Name: Yttrium
elements.Name origin: Ytterby, Sweden, where it was found; see terbium, erbium, ytterbium

elements.Name: Niobium
elements.Name origin: Niobe, daughter of king Tantalus in Greek myth; see tantalum

elements.Name: Molybdenum
elements.Name origin: Greek molýbdaina 'piece of lead', from mólybdos 'lead', due to confusion with lead ore galena (PbS)

elements.Name: Palladium
elements.Name origin: Pallas, asteroid, then considered a planet

elements.Name: Cadmium
elements.Name origin: Neo-Latin cadmia 'calamine', from King Cadmus, mythic founder of Thebes

elements.Name: Indium
elements.Name origin: Latin indicum 'indigo', the blue dye named after India and its color observed in indium's spectral lines

elements.Name: Antimony
elements.Name origin: Latin antimonium, of unclear origin: folk etymologies suggest Greek antí 'against' + mónos 'alone', or Old French anti-moine 'monk's bane', but could be from or related to Arabic ʾiṯmid 'antimony'

elements.Name: Xenon
elements.Name origin: Greek xénon, neuter of xénos 'strange, foreign'

elements.Name: Cerium
elements.Name origin: Ceres (dwarf planet), then considered a planet

elements.Name: Samarium
elements.Name origin: Samarskite, a mineral named after V. Samarsky-Bykhovets, Russian mine official

elements.Name: Gadolinium
elements.Name origin: Gadolinite, a mineral named after Johan Gadolin, Finnish chemist, physicist and mineralogist

elements.Name: Terbium
elements.Name origin: Ytterby, Sweden, where it was found; see yttrium, erbium, ytterbium

elements.Name: Erbium
elements.Name origin: Ytterby, where it was found; see yttrium, terbium, ytterbium

elements.Name: Thulium
elements.Name origin: Thule, the ancient name for an unclear northern location

elements.Name: Ytterbium
elements.Name origin: Ytterby, where it was found; see yttrium, terbium, erbium

elements.Name: Tantalum
elements.Name origin: King Tantalus, father of Niobe in Greek myth; see niobium

elements.Name: Gold
elements.Name origin: English, from same Proto-Indo-European root as 'yellow'

elements.Name: Mercury
elements.Name origin: Mercury, Roman god of commerce, communication, and luck, known for his speed and mobility

elements.Name: Lead
elements.Name origin: English, from Proto-Celtic *ɸloudom, from a root meaning 'flow'

elements.Name: Bismuth
elements.Name origin: German Wismut, via Latin and Arabic from Greek psimúthion 'white lead'

elements.Name: Polonium
elements.Name origin: Latin Polonia 'Poland', home country of discoverer Marie Curie

elements.Name: Astatine
elements.Name origin: Greek ástatos 'unstable'; it has no stable isotopes

elements.Name: Radon
elements.Name origin: Radium emanation, originally the name of 222Rn

elements.Name: Francium
elements.Name origin: France, home country of discoverer Marguerite Perey

elements.Name: Radium
elements.Name origin: Coined in French by discoverer Marie Curie, from Latin radius 'ray'

elements.Name: Thorium
elements.Name origin: Thor, the Norse god of thunder

elements.Name: Protactinium
elements.Name origin: English prefix proto- (from Greek prôtos 'first, before') + actinium; protactinium decays into actinium.

elements.Name: Plutonium
elements.Name origin: Pluto, dwarf planet, then considered a planet

elements.Name: Americium
elements.Name origin: Americas, where the element was first synthesized, by analogy with its homolog europium

elements.Name: Curium
elements.Name origin: Pierre and Marie Curie, physicists and chemists

elements.Name: Berkelium
elements.Name origin: Berkeley, California, where it was first synthesized

elements.Name: Californium
elements.Name origin: California, where it was first synthesized in LBNL

elements.Name: Mendelevium
elements.Name origin: Dmitri Mendeleev, Russian chemist who proposed the periodic table

elements.Name: Nobelium
elements.Name origin: Alfred Nobel, Swedish chemist and engineer

elements.Name: Rutherfordium
elements.Name origin: Ernest Rutherford, chemist and physicist from New Zealand

elements.Name: Dubnium
elements.Name origin: Dubna, Russia, where it was discovered in JINR

elements.Name: Hassium
elements.Name origin: Neo-Latin Hassia 'Hesse', a state in Germany

elements.Name: Darmstadtium
elements.Name origin: Darmstadt, Germany, where it was first synthesized in the GSI labs

elements.Name: Nihonium
elements.Name origin: Japanese Nihon 'Japan', where it was first synthesized in Riken

elements.Name: Flerovium
elements.Name origin: Flerov Laboratory of Nuclear Reactions, part of JINR, where it was synthesized; itself named after Georgy Flyorov, Russian physicist

elements.Name: Moscovium
elements.Name origin: Moscow, Russia, where it was first synthesized in JINR

elements.Name: Livermorium
elements.Name origin: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory in Livermore, California
